fields.System.Title: INV-103 — Query available quantity for a warehouse
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an integration client, I want one number saying how much of a product I can sell, so
that the webshop does not promise stock that is reserved, quarantined, or expired.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a product and warehouse, when I query availability, then I get on-hand minus
  • reserved, summed across sellable locations only.
  • - Given stock in quarantine, damaged status, or a blocked location, then it is excluded.
  • - Given an expired batch, then it is excluded.
  • - Given stock in a virtual location, then it is excluded.
  • - Given several products in one request, then all are returned in one response.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory, masterdata |
| Tables | stock_balance, batch, location |
| Risks | This query becomes slow at volume — see [INV-9](../../features/INV/INV-9-availability-projection.md) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
